name: OUR COMBO SAUNA MODEL – THE A+
description:
For sensitive folks, traditional and “combo” models can be ordered with more glass than the FIR models. You select the amount!
Heavenly Heat Saunas offers one “Combo” model – the 2-person “A+” with 4 FIR heaters; however, any traditional model can be ordered as a “Combo” by selecting IR options.
